splits.final_audit_policy: freeze candidate before first use; never reuse as fresh independent evidence after tuning on results
splits.eligible_row_counts: pending builder validation; do not invent
splits.boundary_policy: One excluded day between partitions; training-label and parameter-selection event end must precede the next forecast cutoff. Retraining moves comparisons beyond its new training/selection cutoff.

review.meaning: Agent checks source identity, observed values and task alignment; not a fabricated human business sign-off
review.retrain_change: Fixed alpha 1 to 10 on the same dataset; not selected by promotion or final results

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap by trading day
uncertainty.interpretation: interval crossing zero means inconclusive, not equivalence

gate.initial: D-2 baseline only; no gain claim
gate.upgrade: paired 7-day block bootstrap upper95(delta MAE)<0 and RMSE<=incumbent

evaluation.terminal_audit: One frozen alpha=10 candidate per new task; never reopen the existing RT-price final audit

data_semantics.power: Original signed public regional PV output; no label clipping or synthetic replacement
data_semantics.day_ahead: Native hour-end DA or mean of four explicit quarters; partial hours excluded
data_semantics.spread: Complete-hour RT mean minus hour-aligned DA, not the final RT quarter
data_semantics.intraday: Rolling historical replay, using event-time observations delayed at least one hour; original arrival times unverified
data_semantics.source_forecast_columns: Excluded from train and inference inputs

reuse.policy: Preserve and validate existing trained model, retraining lineage and consumed final audit; no identical reruns

business.rule: Saved day-ahead PV forecast to hourly DA plus quarter-hour RT deviation settlement
business.negative_forecast_bid: max(forecast,0) only in bidding rule, never mutate model output or labels
business.controls: All-RT settlement on the same complete-hour observations and fees
business.qualification: Regional historical research sandbox, not site production or certified market settlement
